flaws.F: Frame 1 turns into a taller, longer-legged figure with the sword tip cut off, and both feet slide around through the lunge.
flaws.K: A heavy purple outline on every generated frame clashes with the dark-outlined frame 0, and frame 6 swells in size.
flaws.H: Clean but a bit safe: the swing and contact stay fairly upright, and there are magenta specks on the sword hand in frames 3 and 5.
flaws.M: Nearly the same as H but with more magenta fringing and a slightly larger, spikier-haired head at the follow-through.
flaws.S: The frame-2 face looks like another character, and an olive blotch appears on the shorts in frames 3-6.
flaws.P: The lunge is strong, but heavy magenta fringing, stretched legs in frames 4-5 and a 6 px foot pop in the settle frame hurt consistency.
flaws.B: The body is a rigid cut-out with only a blurry, washed-out sword arm swinging, and the contact pose stays upright.
flaws.D: It is not a strike at all: the sword never leaves the ready angle while the whole figure slides left and back.

strike.notes: For the ordering test I told frame 0 from the settle frame partly by comparing candidate ready frames across letters, since the ref is shared. D's poses were too alike to order (I swapped 1/2 and 3/4); H's 6/7 swap was a near-identical pair. F and K have the strongest key poses. H, M, S and P are close to each other.
